content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkTriggerTransmit callback, the RTE shall pass through the following INOUT parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_<CGI> call: • PduInfoPtr The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_- <CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkTrig- gerTransmit callback.
